uncrpd.screenLabel: Écran informations et guide d'application UNCRPD
uncrpd.title: Cadre UNCRPD et guide d'application
uncrpd.intro: La Convention des Nations Unies relative aux droits des personnes handicapées (UNCRPD) définit des obligations mondiales pour respecter, protéger et réaliser les droits liés au handicap. Ce guide aide à naviguer textes de base, Observations générales, outils de suivi et voies pratiques d'application.

sections.coreTexts: Textes de base et Observations générales

workflow.heading: Flux pratique
workflow.step1: 1. Identifier les articles UNCRPD pertinents et toute Observation générale clarificatrice.
workflow.step2: 2. Aligner faits et obstacles avec le texte du traité (droits touchés, obligations déclenchées).
workflow.step3: 3. Rassembler preuves de soutien (chronologies, notes médicales, dossiers d'aménagement).
workflow.step4: 4. Formuler demandes ou mémoires en citant articles + impact en langage simple.
workflow.step5: 5. Référencer guides de suivi / mise en œuvre pour suivi ou escalade.
workflow.step6: 6. Suivre résultats et itérer – mettre à jour preuves et cartographie des articles au besoin.

indicator.title: Conseils conception indicateurs
indicator.body: Utiliser modèle HCDH : Structure (lois/mandats), Processus (couverture programmes, participation), Résultat (maintien en emploi, délais résolution aménagements, réduction suppression réclamations).

about.title: About & Contact
about.intro1: 3mpwr App supports injured workers, the disability community, advocates and allies with tools, resources, and updates.
about.intro2: Vision: a full lifecycle empowerment hub - starting with Health (tracking, medical resources), moving into Claims/Appeals (legal + advocacy tools), into Recovery (wellness + return to work), and ending in Collective Action (campaigns, systemic change). One home for both survival and transformation.
about.intro3: Questions, suggestions, or requests? Reach out anytime.

legal.title: Legal Disclaimer
legal.compact: Educational only — not legal advice. Consult official sources and qualified legal professionals.

medical.title: Medical Disclaimer
medical.compact: Not medical advice. Consult healthcare providers for medical decisions.
medical.full: This app does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Information is for educational purposes only. Always consult qualified healthcare providers for medical decisions. In medical emergencies, call 911 or your local emergency number immediately.

wellness.title: Wellness Disclaimer
wellness.compact: Adapt activities to your abilities. Stop if experiencing pain or distress.
wellness.full: Wellness tools are suggestions only. Always adapt activities to your current abilities and stop immediately if you experience pain, distress, or worsening symptoms. These tools do not replace professional healthcare or crisis intervention services.

emergency.title: Emergency Services
emergency.compact: For emergencies, call 911 or your local emergency number immediately.
emergency.full: This app is not for emergency situations. If you are in immediate danger or experiencing a medical emergency, call 911 (Canada) or your local emergency number immediately. For mental health crisis, go to your nearest emergency department or call a crisis line.

ai.title: AI Tools Disclaimer
ai.compact: AI suggestions are not professional advice. Review and verify all outputs.
ai.full: AI-generated content is for informational purposes only and may contain errors. AI suggestions are not professional legal, medical, or other advice. Always review, verify, and adapt AI outputs for your specific situation. Human professional judgment supersedes AI recommendations.

community.title: Community Disclaimer
community.compact: Community content reflects individual experiences, not professional advice.
community.full: Community discussions reflect individual experiences and opinions, not professional advice. The app does not endorse user-generated content. Use community information as starting points for your own research and professional consultation.

data.title: Data Export Disclaimer
data.compact: Protect exported data. Remove personal identifiers before sharing.
data.full: Exported data may contain sensitive personal information. Protect files with strong passwords, store securely, and remove personal identifiers before sharing. You are responsible for data security after export.

cultural.title: Cultural Safety
cultural.compact: Approach cultural information with respect and consult community-specific resources.
cultural.full: Cultural information is provided for general awareness. Approach with respect, recognize diversity within communities, and consult community-specific resources and leaders for culturally appropriate guidance.

crisis.title: Crisis Support
crisis.compact: Crisis tools are not emergency services. Get immediate help if in danger.
crisis.full: Crisis support tools are supplementary only and not emergency intervention services. If you are in immediate danger, having thoughts of self-harm, or experiencing a mental health crisis, seek immediate professional help through emergency services or crisis lines.
